title: AdapterDefinition
description: AX Harness v1 vendor adapter. An adapter describes where a vendor tool reads its instructions and which shared documents that entrypoint defers to. An adapter is a surface, never a competing architecture, and holds no capabilities of its own.

entrypoint.description: Repository-relative file the vendor tool loads first.

sharedInstructions.description: Vendor-neutral documents this adapter surfaces to its tool. All must exist in the repository.

repoPath.description: Relative Markdown path using forward slashes. Absolute paths and parent traversal are forbidden.
